findings.finding: Fold, seed, parent checkpoint, propensity ancestry and component subsample all vary together between F0/1001 and F1/1002.
findings.consequence: Keep every contrast fold-local. Do not pool the two cells as a seed estimate or attribute cross-fold score differences to the head arm.

findings.finding: The parent predictions used on selected fitting groups are in-sample, while parent predictions on the full evaluation fold are held out by the split.
findings.consequence: Label the fit cache explicitly in-sample and never compare it as an evaluation endpoint; the evaluation parent cache must be a separate complete endpoint.

findings.finding: The two full validation folds are already exposed development evidence, and only two fold/seed cells are present.
findings.consequence: Component intervals quantify conditional evaluation-unit uncertainty for fixed fitted endpoints, not training-seed variation, a fresh holdout, or generalization to unseen folds.

findings.finding: The reviewed recipe freezes 12 proposed cells but records zero admitted fits and a deferred status.
findings.consequence: The grader must not treat the code, profile, or a partial artifact set as a completed quality panel. It must require a root-frozen runnable recipe and all 14 verified endpoints before opening the target cache.

findings.finding: A permissive row-alignment helper can accept a prediction superset and reorder rows.
findings.consequence: Require exact source-qualified evaluation refs, exact ordered row-group membership and little-endian int64 membership digest, plus NPY header/payload coverage, before scoring.

planned_grade.primary_intervals: Overall global_wp_clip2_v1 only, paired by dependency component within each fold.
planned_grade.conditional_points: Both target correlations and four fixed position-bin scores for every contrast.
planned_grade.resampling_scope: Fixed-endpoint component resampling; no seed/fold pooling or best-lag significance claim.

limitations: Code-only review of the frozen recipe and grading contract. No candidate outputs existed and no targets or quality scores were read.
